meta.title: FadeUp — Find and book your next barber
meta.description: Discover great barbers and barbershops near you. Real prices, real availability, live queues. Book in seconds.

hero.title: Great barbers. Booked in seconds.
hero.sub: FadeUp shows you who is good, what it costs and when they are free — then books it in a few taps.

discovery.title: Know before you go.
discovery.fieldLabel: Real locations of the results shown

culture.title: It is never just a haircut.
culture.body: A fresh cut is how you walk into the week. FadeUp is built by people who know the difference between a trim and a transformation — and it treats your barber like the craftsman they are.
culture.imageAlt: A barber finishing a fresh skin fade at the nape with clippers

booking.title: Service. Time. Done.
booking.body: No accounts before you need one, no forms that ask twice, no guessing. Pick the cut, pick the moment, confirm.

independent.title: Barbers on their own terms.
independent.body: Some of the best barbers do not stand behind a shop window. On FadeUp, independent professionals are first-class: their own profile, their own prices, their own chair — wherever it stands.

queue.title: Your place in line. Live.
queue.body: Scan at the shop, take your spot, and watch it move in real time. FadeUp never invents waiting minutes — it shows your real position and who is ahead, nothing else.

passport.title: Your cut, on record.
passport.body: Every FadeUp customer carries a Fade Passport: your cut, your preferences, your barber relationships — yours, portable, and shown only when you choose to share it.

follow.title: Booking is just the start.
follow.body: Your barber moves — new shop, new city, new work. Follow them on FadeUp and the relationship survives the move. Booking again is one tap, not a search.
follow.demoSub: Working at a barbershop near you

pro.title: Run the day. Fill the chairs.
pro.outcome1: See your whole day at a glance
pro.outcome2: Fill quiet hours with real bookings
pro.outcome3: Know your clients and bring them back
pro.outcome4: Operate every location from one place
